note: Golden transitions for demo-run@1 (framework/core/live-demo.mjs). `runs` replays event lists (at = seconds after `now`) on the seed run and records the trace, the final state, the summary and the check-list; `errors` replays sequences that must be refused; `norm` replays normRun + validateRun on raw records. Regenerate the `out` blocks with: node framework/spec/check-live-demo.mjs --write

acts.title: A build appears in Pending
acts.caption: A throwaway build is created; watch its row appear in the Pending grid.

acts.title: Queue it
acts.caption: The build moves from Pending to the Queue and takes its place.

acts.title: Watch it die
acts.caption: The session is killed on purpose (exit 143). The row goes red and the banner says what failed.

runs.name: pause on: overlay → act 1 pass → Next → 30 s → act 2 pass → Next → 30 s → act 3 dies (pass: it was meant to) → Next → 30 s → done
pause off: every finish goes straight into the 30 s gap, no Next

result.error: expected a kill, got a clean exit

failed.title: Watch it die

runs.name: pause flipped on the Next bar: on for act 1, off from act 2
a longer gap (45 s) is honoured
a gap asked below 30 s runs at 30 s
skip in focusing: skipped, then the gap
stop while running: the act is skipped (stopped), the run is stopped by brett
stop on the overlay: nothing started
the driver stops on an error during the gap
finish carries its own times: the duration is theirs
